notes: DECISION: the indigo circle is kept because it is the mark's own app-icon shape (the white envelope needs it). thanks.io's header/docs lockup instead uses a purple #6300CC outline envelope with speed lines (raster on the homepage). An SVG of that envelope exists in the company's own GitHub (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thanks-io/n8n-nodes-thanks-io/main/nodes/ThanksIo/icons/thanksIo.svg, saved at downloads/thanks-io/src4/) and inside the docs logo (https://mintcdn.com/thanksio/jRViseKcOKEicv0x/logo/dark.svg, src3), but its path data carries a PNG-to-SVG vectorizer signature ('M0 0 C1.16181486 -0.00256327 ...', dozens of micro-curves with slightly uneven line ends), i.e. a trace, so it was not shipped. If the reviewer prefers the envelope lockup mark, that file is the only vector of it.
